 Real Sociedad could overtake Espanyol to go seventh in all-time La Liga standings with win 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article If Real Sociedad beat Levante this afternoon, they will climb to seventh in La Liga's all-time standings. According to Diario Vasco, the milestone has been long awaited by supporters.
 A victory would take them to 3,094 points across their 80th La Liga season.
 OneFootball Videos
 Espanyol lost 2-1 at Racing Santander yesterday.
 That tally would match Espanyol's, and with an overall goal difference of +51 against Espanyol's -361, Real would sit above them in the table.
 It may be one for the purists, but it also underlines Real's historical weight in the competition.
 Source: Diario Vasco
